checks.name: syntax
checks.command: bash -n <file> (per shell file; .sh.erb checked as its ERB-stripped copy)
checks.note: bash 3.2.57 on PATH: failures may be false; install bash >= 4 to confirm

checks.name: shellcheck
checks.command: shellcheck --norc -f json -S info <file> (per shell file; .sh.erb scanned as its ERB-stripped copy)
checks.note: apt install shellcheck / brew install shellcheck

checks.name: trivy
checks.command: trivy fs --format json --scanners vuln,misconfig,secret --skip-dirs vendor --skip-dirs node_modules --config <out-dir>/trivy-empty.yaml --ignorefile <out-dir>/trivy-empty.ignore <repo>/tests/fixtures/containerized-server

checks.name: catalog
checks.note: catalog reads land in a later PR

facts.name: readme
facts.command: README headings, placeholder lines (references/readme-placeholders.txt), screenshots, env vars, rungs

facts.name: form
facts.command: form.yml / form.yml.erb (ERB stripped) attributes, cross-referenced with submit.yml.erb
facts.note: YAML parser: built-in subset (PyYAML not importable)

facts.name: template
facts.command: template/ scan: icons, site paths, numeric literals, commented-out code (bash -n)
facts.note: bash 3.2.57 on PATH: a commented block using bash 4 syntax is not reported as commented_code

facts.name: entry_point
facts.command: Passenger entry point: compile() / ruby -c / node --check, dependency manifest

facts.name: security
facts.command: candidate sites per kind (references/security-tools.md, Candidate enumeration)
